## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the concrete problem and what changes for someone using the application.

## Validation

List relevant checks, results, and platforms actually tested.

## Review notes

Mention compatibility changes or new file, network, model, notification, or permission behavior.

- [ ] Relevant isolated checks pass without live board or model-account side effects.
- [ ] Documentation matches the final behavior.
- [ ] Private runtime data, personal settings, and credentials are excluded.
- [ ] Changes preserve local-only defaults or document the boundary change.
- [ ] Contributions are compatible with the MIT license.
